name: Air Jordan 11 Retro Low 'UNC' 2026
story_html: The 2026 edition of the Air Jordan 11 Retro Low 'UNC' brings back a two-tone colorway of the classic silhouette that pays homage to Michael Jordan's alma mater. Faithful to the original 2001 release, the low-top features a white leather upper with a glossy patent leather mudguard in University Blue. Anchoring the sneaker is a white lightweight Phylon midsole that houses a full-length Air-Sole unit. Underfoot, the translucent rubber outsole reveals a carbon fiber spring plate for enhanced stability and energy return.
